interface.title: hydro-capacity-api (纳污能力计算 — river/reservoir pollutant receiving-capacity calculation), driven through its auto-generated Swagger UI at /docs
interface.field: Water environment engineering / river water-quality management (pollutant receiving capacity of river functional zones)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis: running the capacity model on prepared hydrological and zone-parameter data, then exporting results for reporting
interface.what_it_is_for: Upload an Excel workbook of functional-zone, tributary and daily-flow data for one or more pollution scenarios, and get back daily and monthly pollutant receiving capacity per zone, either as JSON or as a multi-sheet Excel file.

data.note: Uploaded 示例输入.xlsx to POST /api/compute. I also downloaded the same built-in sample from GET /api/sample (sample_input.xlsx, 7,522,815 bytes). The sample has 9 functional zones (钱塘156–161, 钱塘23–25). Each zone has one main-stem segment (Cs=0.03, K=2.31e-6 1/s, b, a, β, length 4,000–15,300 m, C0=0.02) and one tributary segment (-1) that joins at mid-reach (汇入位置 2,000–7,650 m). Every tributary has length 0 and C0 0. Daily flows run from 1961-01-01 (23,010 rows). It holds only 1 scenario and no reservoir (meta: zoneCount 9, schemeCount 1, hasReservoir false, elapsedMs 47322; read from the downloaded JSON downloads/response_1793574661455.json).

tree.general: Estimate how much pollutant each reach of a river can take, day by day and month by month, from a parameter workbook, and export the results

features.name: Workbook-in, model-results-out compute endpoint with output-format switch

Open the daily, monthly, zone monthly-average, process and final result tables

features.check_note: Not replayed. The five table names are present in the downloaded JSON results; the run read only 逐日纳污能力, and per-scenario (方案N) tagging and reservoir tables were not exercised because the sample has one scheme and no reservoir.

screens_never_reached: Any graphical front end (charts, tables, scenario selector): this repo ships only the FastAPI service and Swagger UI, and there is no root page
Reservoir results (monthly storage volume / reservoir capacity): the sample workbook has no reservoir zone (meta.hasReservoir false)
Multi-scenario results (方案2 and later): the sample defines only one scenario (schemeCount 1, X-Scheme-Count 1)
Error responses (400 / 500) from POST /api/compute: no empty or malformed upload was tried
not_done: Prepare an input workbook from the template (set scenarios 方案N, zone parameters and tributary segments): the browser cannot edit a workbook, so only the built-in sample was used.
Compare capacity across several pollution scenarios: the only test file has a single 逐日流量 scenario, and the browser cannot edit the workbook to add a second.
Check the reservoir branch: the sample has no reservoir zone, so this path could not be exercised.

See how tributaries affect downstream capacity: tributaries are listed in preview.branches with their 汇入位置, but no with/without comparison was possible because the input cannot be edited here. The tributary flows are tiny in the sample, and every tributary has length 0 and C0 0.

Read and interpret the monthly results: the downloaded JSON's results also contain 逐月纳污能力 (monthly capacity per zone), 功能区月平均纳污能力 (each zone's average by calendar month), 纳污能力过程 (process table) and 纳污能力结果 (final result table), and capacity_result.xlsx holds the same tables, but the explorer read only results.逐日纳污能力; the xlsx is binary and the download reader only reports its size.

Each compute call kept the browser on LOADING for several minutes, though the server reported 47 s of compute. While it ran, the server answered nothing else: /openapi.json in a second tab timed out. That limited further experiments within the action budget.
I did not try the error path (upload with no file or a malformed workbook), the HTTPValidationError/ValidationError schemas, or the Media type and Example Value/Schema tabs beyond seeing them.
